primary_ecological_metric.name: balanced_presence_background_log_score
primary_ecological_metric.taxon_gain: sdmr_process_first minus matched_learner_flat_predictive_selector on sealed answer-check

prediction_guardrail.evaluable_denominator_rule: all 50 taxa must have an evaluable SDMR primary route; any unavailable taxon makes EMP-C fail

model_pool_background_split.row_count_interpretation: 4000/1000 are nominal frozen rank-split denominators before the predeclared complete-case filter; fitting and sealed scoring use only complete-case rows within their respective frozen rank subsets

stage_p.background_group_assignment: nearest model-pool occurrence spatial_block by great-circle distance; deterministic nearest occurrence_id tie-break
stage_p.identical_process_closure_policy: sharp states with identical closure are converted to unresolved

stability.denominator: all 50 taxa x 6 declared processes; unresolved/unavailable count as not stable

predictor_filter_rule: derive stable process states before any answer-check feature is opened
drop a predictor only when every declared process mapped to it is stably replaceable
retain predictors mapped to any contributory required unresolved or unavailable process
retain shared-carrier predictors whenever any mapped process is not stably replaceable
if the full system is unavailable for the taxon the SDMR route is unavailable rather than rescued
sdmr_process_first_prediction.representation_refinement: not part of primary EMP-A to EMP-F test

flat_comparators.inner_grouping: same frozen model-pool groups and training background as SDMR

auc_oriented_flat_selector.algorithm: deterministic sequential forward selection over all 46 predictors by mean inner-spatial-CV ROC AUC
auc_oriented_flat_selector.stopping: evaluate prefixes 1..8 and choose maximum mean AUC; ties fewer predictors then lexicographic sequence

correlation_vif_flat_filter.algorithm: VIF pruning on training-background environmental predictors only

matched_learner_flat_predictive_selector.algorithm: deterministic sequential forward selection over all 46 predictors by mean inner-spatial-CV balanced log score
matched_learner_flat_predictive_selector.stopping: evaluate prefixes 1..8 and choose maximum mean balanced log score; ties fewer predictors then lexicographic sequence

promotion.EMP-D: stable process fraction >= 0.80 under frozen 50x6 denominator

answer_check_opening_order: run all model-pool SDMR process states and flat comparator selections
freeze per-taxon process states retained predictor sets comparator sets and fitted-model specifications
only then materialize answer-check coordinates/environmental values once
score all frozen routes on same sealed answer-check occurrences and frozen 1000-row evaluation background
apply EMP-A through EMP-F without retuning
prohibited: change EMP thresholds after feature or answer-check values are seen
change learner hyperparameters after model fitting begins
change process margin adequacy floor permutation gate or stability rule after fitting
use answer-check outcomes for process-state classification or predictor selection
drop unavailable taxa or unresolved process cells from declared denominators
bind a cohort other than the first 50 jointly eligible taxa from frozen v5 preeligibility
